name: @local/dsh-workflow-ptc
description: Workflow orchestration in the shared sandboxed Node PTC runtime — local build adding token/time budgets, a size-guideline warning, a one-level nesting guard, and journal-backed resume.

changes: Token and elapsed-time budgets per run, configurable and lowerable per call; an exhausted budget refuses further agent() calls while the script still returns gathered results.
Size-guideline warning when a run starts more agents than the deployment's threshold.
One-level nesting guard: a workflow child session may not start another workflow.
Per-run JSONL journal and prefix replay behind resume_from_run_id, stopping at the first changed agent() call.

schemaRetries (default 5) is limited to read-only runs with missing structured output. Writable, failed and cancelled child executions are not automatically retried; token usage accumulates across allowed read-only attempts.

Preserve configured parallelism; enforce overlapping writable-root and shared-browser admission, retain uncertain leases, use native read-only workers and fresh linked sessions for genuinely isolated cwd; bind per-call execution capabilities to replay.
Confine the orchestration process to the native read-only sandbox independently of admitted worker permissions; node:vm is not a filesystem security boundary.
Retain a failed writable result's directory lease until the current script settles, rejecting replacement writers without blocking unrelated isolated work.
